trans-unit.source: The /t/<slug> handle of your RatingStar location. Drives seal.js and the slug-based endpoints.
Format rs_live_ followed by 40 alphanumeric characters. Rename-safe; powers the key-based endpoints and Google stars. Rotate it in the RatingStar admin.
Origin from which seal.js, data and JSON-LD are loaded. Leave empty to use https://ratingstar.de.
The API key must have the format rs_live_ followed by 40 alphanumeric characters.
